contract.description: Each row is one decompile request for a single function entry. Success means the adapter returned that function unit, not a whole-program dump (DCE/Dogbolt-style).

normalization_contract.shared: Any-tool measurable subjects stay in every tool's metric denominator; a missing peer measurement is a miss.
normalization_contract.intersection: Restrict scope to subjects for which every active decompiler produced usable requested-function output.

measurement_health.difficulty_contract: Structural proxy: easy >= 2/3 exact GED agreement, hard <= 1/3, medium otherwise; unmeasured is explicit.
measurement_health.cost_contract: Per-function wall time is comparable within this run. USD is null unless an explicit priced execution source exists.

bare_compile.note: Bare-compile is a form-quality diagnostic; not used for semantic ranking.

recompilation.note: Same-ABI/toolchain normalized assembly match; semantic execution remains ranking.

readability_axis.note: Readability proxies (goto, temp density, flag soup) are diagnostics only. No composite readability rank is published.

tracks.note: Track/language/ISA/opt pivots are extension diagnostics. Official ranking remains semantic pass rate on the core C PE cohort.

speed.note: Decompile latency diagnostics only. Not a semantic ranking axis. Row times are adapter wall-clock; microbench adds cold/warm trials.

microbench.notes: cold = first timed /decompile_batch after optional discarded warmups; warm = trials 2..N on the same process (no container restart). adapter_ms prefers server-reported time_ms; wall_ms is client RTT. CPU may exceed 100% on multicore hosts; peak memory is the maximum observed sample, not an OS high-water mark.
